# appleads_product_page (Data Source)

Fetches a single custom product page via Apple Ads `GET /apps/{adamId}/product-pages/{productPageId}`.

Custom product pages are owned and edited in [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com); the Ads API is **read-only** here. Use `id` / `product_page_id` when creating creatives/ads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_product_page" "example" {
  adam_id         = "899247964"
  product_page_id = "45812c9b-c296-43d3-c6a0-c5a02f74bf6e"
}

output "product_page_name" {
  value = data.appleads_product_page.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adam_id` (String) Adam ID (App Store identifier) of the app that owns the product page.
- `product_page_id` (String) Product page UUID from App Store Connect (path segment / query `?ppid=` on the App Store URL).

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) Creation timestamp from Apple Ads.
- `deep_link` (String) Deep link from App Store Connect product page metadata, when set.
- `id` (String) Product page UUID (same value as `product_page_id`).
- `modification_time` (String) Last modification timestamp from Apple Ads.
- `name` (String) Custom product page display name.
- `state` (String) `VISIBLE` or `HIDDEN`.
